VBL.d: Varun Beverages manufactures, packages, and distributes carbonated and non-carbonated beverages. It is one of the largest international franchisees of PepsiCo outside the United States.

VEDL.d: Vedanta Limited is a diversified natural resources company producing oil and gas, zinc, lead, silver, copper, aluminum, iron ore, and power. It serves global industrial and manufacturing customers.

VGUARD.d: V-Guard Industries Limited manufactures and sells household appliances, voltage stabilizers, electric water heaters, pumps, and cables. Its primary end markets are residential consumers across India.

VIJAYA.d: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre provides diagnostic and healthcare testing services, including pathology and radiology. It operates a network of diagnostic centers and laboratories primarily in southern India.

VINATIORGA.d: Vinati Organics Limited manufactures specialty chemical products including monomers, polymers, and other organic intermediates. Its main customers are chemical and industrial companies globally.

VMM.d: Vishal Mega Mart operates a chain of hypermarkets across India offering apparel, general merchandise, and grocery items. It caters to value-conscious retail consumers in tier-2 and tier-3 cities.

VOLTAS.d: Voltas Limited manufactures cooling products like air conditioners and commercial refrigerators, while also providing engineering projects and services. Its customers include residential, commercial, and industrial end markets across India.

VTL.d: Vardhman Textiles manufactures cotton yarn, synthetic yarn, and processed fabric for domestic and international apparel markets. It is one of the largest vertically integrated textile producers in India.
